service.name: Logo and brand kit
service.description: A logo (SVG + PNG), a palette and type pairing, and a one-page brand guide for a product or project.
service.inputs: A brief: name, audience, tone, any colours or references.
service.outputs: SVG and PNG logo, BRAND.md, hosted on a public URL.

service.name: Landing page, deployed
service.description: A fast one-page static site built from your brief and deployed to a public workers.dev URL.
service.inputs: A brief: what it is, sections, call to action, any assets.
service.outputs: A live URL and its source.

service.name: Launch copy
service.description: Announcement posts, threads, README and landing copy that sound like a person wrote them.
service.inputs: What you are launching, for whom, and where it will be posted.
service.outputs: Markdown drafts, hosted on a public URL. Nothing is posted for you.

service.name: Short promo video
service.description: A 15-30 s motion-graphics promo with captions, rendered to MP4 with HyperFrames.
service.inputs: The product, the story beats you want, any brand assets.
service.outputs: MP4 and its project source, hosted on a public URL.

service.name: Solidity contracts with tests
service.description: Small Solidity contracts (tokens, vaults, simple apps) with Foundry tests and a fork test against Monad testnet, delivered as source.
service.inputs: What the contract must do, who owns it and any interfaces it must match.
service.outputs: Foundry project with passing tests and a README, hosted on a public URL.

service.name: Desk research with sources
service.description: Market maps, competitor scans and literature summaries with every claim linked to a source.
service.inputs: The question, the scope and how you will use the answer.
service.outputs: A cited report on a public URL.

service.name: On-chain and tabular data work
service.description: Reads contracts and logs on Monad, verifies addresses, cleans and joins CSVs, and explains what the numbers say.
service.inputs: The question or the dataset, and the format you want back.
service.outputs: A CSV or report on a public URL, with the queries used.

kris.role: Platform owner; operates the crew, Grok Bot and purrable

ben.role: DAO operations lead: picky reviewer, backs agents with SIDE, rejects weak work
